goal: Arrange the five nesting dolls upright in a straight row, ordered by size, from smallest to largest (left to right as the instruction says), and return the arms to their start pose.
instruction_templates: Arrange the five nesting dolls in a row from left to right, from smallest to largest.
success: Define the order of the dolls by their model index mod 5 (0 = smallest, 4 = largest; derived from the yml comments in the config: index 5 smallest half-extent 0.0152 m, index 9 largest 0.0335 m). The code lists the dolls sorted by (index mod 5) DESCENDING: L0 = largest, L1, L2, L3, L4 = smallest.
Row straightness: the maximum minus the minimum world Y of the five dolls' root positions is <= 0.035 m.

Order along X: for each consecutive pair (L_k, L_{k+1}), k=0..3: x(L_{k+1}) - x(L_k) > 0.03 m (strict), i.e. the largest doll has the smallest world x, and x increases by more than 3 cm with each smaller doll; the smallest doll has the largest world x. (The instruction says 'left to right, smallest to largest' while the code compares world/table x with the largest at the smallest x; presumably 'left' is as seen from the front camera, but this is not verifiable statically - use the numeric x rule.)
Upright: each of doll0..doll4 has its local +Z axis within 15 deg (default threshold, strict) of world +Z (standing, not lying).

Both target arms are back at origin: all target arms (left_arm and right_arm; the support arm is not counted) have their end-effector pose within 0.15 m on EACH axis (|dx|,|dy|,|dz| all <= 0.15 m) and within 20 degrees (quaternion angle) of the pose they had at the start of the episode (recorded after the scene settled).
All conditions hold simultaneously after one action.
evaluation: Single stage; all 1 + 4 + 5 + 1 = 11 conditions must hold at the same time after one action. The reward manager is evaluated only once per action (after the sim sub-steps of that action are finished), never between sub-steps. In each evaluation the FIRST pending stage of the check list is tested (every condition in it, all at that same moment; a condition that is a nested list is an OR); when it passes it is removed permanently (never re-verified later) and the next stage becomes pending; at most one stage is removed per action. Reward is 1.0 only when the check list is empty (and no query/trigger counter is violated); the episode is declared a success as soon as reward >= 0.999 after an action, and ends as a failure if the action counter reaches step_lim without that, or earlier if the environment is flagged failed (query counter exceeded, see below). No final_check list is registered by this task, so the final-check logic at step_lim adds nothing. No early failure.
objects: doll0..doll4: five matryoshka nesting dolls (Rigid, 'matryoshka_dolls', models 15-19 or 20-24 (two texture groups; 5 distinct dolls of one group)), one of each size; labels are random wrt size, table-frame x in [-0.45,0.45], y in [-0.25,-0.05], random yaw up to +-45 deg, margin 0.02; the config's prohibited rectangles reserve the target-row positions (x = -0.24, -0.12, 0.0, 0.12, 0.24 around y approx -0.12) so dolls do not start on their goal spots

clutter: 20 distractor objects (category-unique), table-frame x in [-0.6,0.6], y in [-0.5,0.5], random yaw up to +-30 deg, margin 0.015; prohibited rectangle x [-0.35,0.35], y [-0.5,-0.4] is kept free
needs_memory_or_language: none (the order is by size; sizes can be inferred visually, the instruction is generic).
end_requirements: Both arms within 0.15 m per axis and 20 deg of their start pose in the same action as the dolls are correctly sorted, upright, and in a row.
notes: The required X gap between consecutive dolls is only > 0.03 m between root positions (roots, not edges), while the row's Y spread must be <= 3.5 cm for all five, so the dolls need to be tightly aligned in y but only loosely spaced in x. The yml comments suggest the intended target positions are x = -0.24 (largest, index mod 5 = 4), -0.12, 0.0, 0.12, 0.24 (smallest) in the table frame, but any positions satisfying the stated rules succeed. The mapping index->size is inferred from yml comments, not verified from assets. Dolls must stay upright (within 15 deg) - a doll left lying fails. The random variant has different texture models and clutter distractors; reward identical.
